factors.name: IndiaSemiconductorEcosystemExpansion
factors.basis: Teradyne announced a permanent India office and participation in SEMICON India, adding current primary evidence of local commercial/support presence as India scales fabrication, packaging and test capacity.

risks: A local office and ecosystem participation establish presence, not booked demand, market share, pricing power or realized revenue.
unknowns: No India-specific bookings, revenue, customer commitments, capacity or margin contribution were disclosed.
Alpha retains numeric underwriting and factor calibration authority.

factors.name: GeographicExecution
factors.basis: The September 14 opening provides dated execution evidence that Teradyne converted India semiconductor-market intent into an operating local presence, complementing existing product-roadmap evidence.

risks: Geographic expansion can add operating cost before local demand converts into material sales.
unknowns: Commercial conversion timing and financial contribution remain undisclosed.

observedFacts: Teradyne announced a permanent office in India and an office-opening event on September 15, 2026.
Teradyne stated it would participate in SEMICON India September 17-19, 2026.
The India Semiconductor Mission CEO described the presence in the context of India's scaling fabrication, packaging and test capabilities.

recommendation: Reuse as current source-addressed geographic execution and ecosystem-positioning evidence; do not infer numeric demand, revenue, pricing power or score values from the office opening.
